summary: Add a target-owned ticket activity policy override

delivery.outcome: Adopters can opt into Git-derived terminal ticket resolution through a target-owned override while the managed status-projection default remains conservative.
nonGoals: Do not change the managed default or receipt verification.
Do not allow an override to change registry location, terminal outcomes or unsupported-outcome handling.
Do not treat a carrier-only ticket directory as delivery evidence without the existing Git safety checks.

architecture.decision: Ship a managed schema for a small target-owned override document and have ticket_activity merge only its missingPolicy into the managed policy. The override is opt-in, strict and cannot alter receipt authority.
architecture.rollback: Remove the target-owned override; the managed status-projection policy remains the fallback.

validation.evidence: Default missing registry remains active; a valid target-owned override derives terminal state only when Git proves delivery landed.
All standard suites and exact-base governance pass.
